extracted.name: Espresso eggnog martini
extracted.description: Toast the festive season with our eggnog martini flavoured with espresso. Serve in martini glasses with a grating of nutmeg for the ultimate Christmas tipple
instruction_lines: Put a handful of ice in a cocktail shaker. Add the espresso, rum, coffee liqueur and custard.
Shake well. Pour into a martini or coupe glass. Grate over the nutmeg.
